Synthetic ar/USTAR fixtures generated by `node scripts/generate-deb-fixtures.mjs` (Node 22).
They contain inert text instead of application binaries and image data, and are never installed or executed.
`com.example.app_1.2.3_amd64.deb`: gzip UOS layout, warning for the documented version ambiguity.
`kylin.deb`: uncompressed Kylin layout, deliberately nonstandard filename (warning).
`unsafe.deb`: path traversal, must produce incomplete / exit 2.
Tests independently validate the archives using host ar/tar when available.
